title: Netherlock
description: Mod that adds a better horizontal nether portal, a command to set respawn to nether and a few variants of obsidian block
body:
## Add's a new nether portal block for horizontal big portals
![Image from the new portal block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f892dea5e347c6f31e4c82c4d3b308ec59fc476_0.webp) 
## 4 new obsidian variants for texturing
![New obsidian pallete](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f57fe9e3b68f07aae6bb478d25aae335c66be97c.png)
**Add's a scarf item that change the user atributtes to the ones of a undead mob, including damage with healing potions and healing with damage potions**


![Powered by Lazuli Lib](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8db23e0cd3bfa8aa09abf6d04680c50dcdb00bd.png)
